subject: Leadership meeting: course positioning
body:
2026-10-01T10:00:00+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Before the course-page discussion: Nora needs the missing demo descriptions. The programme can't go to print with half the projects described as title to follow.
2026-10-01T10:00:54+02:00 — Jule Hartmann: I can make the programme work. The course title is harder. Every copy pass ends with us trying to explain away the headline instead of describing the teaching.
2026-10-01T10:01:51+02:00 — Thomas Engel: it's a cash grab that could damage our reputation
2026-10-01T10:02:50+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: I'll record that concern. Keep the title and the outcomes paragraph together for review; we keep discussing them in separate windows and approving different drafts.
2026-10-01T10:03:48+02:00 — Ines Duarte: If you want a financial comparison, send me the registration assumptions. I can calculate a total, but I need to know what question you are asking.
2026-10-01T10:04:45+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Right. Next is support cover during the planning meeting, then the facilities queue. Please don't let the coffee machine use the rest of this meeting.
